aboutGame.title: What is Break and Steal an Egg?
paragraphs: Break and Steal an Egg is a Roblox simulation tycoon by ILGames x Eggs. Players break eggs to hatch animals, take them past guards, and place them at a base to earn cash.
Progress connects animal collecting with speed and pickaxe upgrades. Whether you are securing your first animal or choosing your next Index target, a successful return to base makes each run count.

finalCta.title: Ready to Master Break and Steal an Egg?
finalCta.description: Make your next egg run count. Learn the basics, plan your escape, grow your base income, and choose your next collection goal.
